title: concordance — flat row (the projection)
description: One row per record: the two claims, where ours comes from, the computed agreement, and what the source's licence requires or reveals — the credit, and the operators standing behind it. The last three columns are computed and cannot be authored.

credit.description: the credit the source's licence requires, carried with the data so no view can show the row without it

source_operators.description: who operates the source, pipe-joined. Carried so a reader can see when an 'agreement' is one operator agreeing with itself.
